text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It is Hatsumode, Trainer-dono. Come, let 
us offer our prayers before the altar.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
choice_data_list: Wait, isn't this the wrong place!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No, it's correct. When a knight thinks of 
the New Year, they think of the church.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I wish to... pray here. Taking everything 
into account, I feel I must.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...For the sake of atmosphere, a church 
rather than a shrine. It seems Durandal 
has lines she refuses to cross.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"O God, last year I managed to become a 
full-fledged knight. This year—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I pledge to become the strongest knight. I 
shall guide my King to the throne as 
champion of the Twinkle Series, and—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I shall build it. The "Eternal Kingdom."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So that the King's reign may last 
forever, I wish to build an unshakeable 
kingdom. And—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(I want to be praised... Over and over, 
hearing how well I did and what a 
wonderful job it was...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(If I can build an unshakable standing, 
days full of praise will go on 
forever...!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...*ahem*, excuse me.
choice_data_list:
I see. In that case, we need to get even 
stronger.

Yeah, then you'll need to get even 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: —Yes. Far better than I am now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just Believe and Calstone Light 
O. There were plenty of other strong 
sprint Umamusume in the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to compete against those kinds 
of Umamusume this year too. To do that...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
To build the Everlasting Kingdom— My King, 
can you see it? The vision of who I must 
strive to be this year.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I can see it. Clear as day.
Yeah, I can see it. Clear as day.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: What kind of Umamusume would that be?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ideal image of a knight that Durandal 
should strive for. That is—
choice_data_list:
She's an Uma Musume who's mastered nothing 
but sharpness!

She's an Uma Musume who's mastered nothing 
but sharpness!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Only sharpness... So in other words, you 
mean thoroughly honing just our greatest 
strength?
choice_data_list: Yeah, a knight of one-hit victory!

Yeah, a knight who wins in a single 
strike!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring to pay no heed to anything else. 
Specializing only in her strengths, and 
honing them to the absolute limit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The results will follow. No matter the 
circumstances, as long as I cut through 
everything in the final three furlongs, 
that is all that matters.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A knight who wins in a single strike... So 
cool... ...Ah, no, never mind.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Without resorting to petty 
tricks, I will hone this "Holy Sword" into 
a supreme treasure!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, my vision and Durandal's ideal 
goal aligned into one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The sharpest knight of all. This year 
must mark the year of her birth.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I cannot simply idle 
away this New Year's holiday. I must hone 
myself as a knight.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, how should we spend our 
time?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I think. What I want Durandal to try at 
the start of this new year is...
choice_data_list:
Gorgeous! East vs. West Sword Dance 
Showdown

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I see, looking back on the past. Recalling 
old memories and reflecting on one's 
actions is very important.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Then please listen to my self-admonition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Quietly, I decided to listen to Durandal's 
memoirs.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Pray, lend me your ear. Truth be told, 
this knight, Durandal...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I slice a cake, I simply cannot 
suppress the flutter in my heart...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I accidentally end up muttering things 
like 'Sacred Judgment: Octo-Slash!' Under 
my breath, of course.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
And even when entering the starting gate, 
I just couldn't help letting my 
imagination wander...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"How cowardly! To trap me in a cage like 
this!" it said.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
And just the other day, when I was 
ordering at a family restaurant...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No, let us keep this confidential for now. 
Aside from that, at the home improvement 
center...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Durandal confided her numerous secrets. 
And so, she spent a quiet, reflective time 
looking back on herself.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I see, a sword dance showdown between East 
and West, then. ...As you wish.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Now then, in the spirit of the New Year, 
let us proceed with elegance and splendor.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-ha-ha! To challenge me of all people 
to a sword dance... You've gotten full of 
yourself, Lord Durandal!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Let us have a fair and square match, then! 
I shall go first.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume's fifty years are but an 
empty dream!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
ââ!! No Reason-san looks... so huge... 
Is this... the General's Dance...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
This will test my own caliber. I cannot 
afford to lose...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, through the sword dance showdown, 
Durandal grew into a bigger and better 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
ââ!! Just looking at... sweets... O 
King, how cruel...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
However, if this too is a necessary 
trial...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we arrived at the cafe renowned 
for its delicious sweets.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono?! What in the world is that 
sweet...? I have never seen such a shape 
before...
choice_data_list:
Apparently it's called 'Crème de la 
Crème'.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Crème de la crème... What a deeply... 
soul-stirring name...
choice_data_list: Look, look, the cream's coming out!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Look at that! Inside the cream, there's 
even more cream!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Kh, how delicio— No, what cursed rations 
these are.
choice_data_list:
I'm going to order more and more other 
things!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Such merciless treatment... 
However, I cannot partake of it. In that 
case, at the very least...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Let's at least acquire the knowledge. To 
see what kind of things are trending these 
days...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Durandal endured the torture 
and properly learned about the trendy 
sweets.
